about: Source review for checked alternates in Berlin, Hong Kong and Singapore, 2026-10-19. Draft: nothing here is used by the planner until the owner approves. Every record was read on the operator's own site or the public body that runs it; quotes are short extracts.

source.sourceType: operator's own site (Staatliche Museen zu Berlin)
source.operatingEvidence: Current exhibition 'Scandal! Hermione von Preuschen and the Mors Imperator' (22.03.2026-15.11.2026); 2nd floor closed 29 Sep-21 Oct 2026, 'fully open again from 22 October'.

source.operatingEvidence: Current exhibitions 'Next Door' (09.10.2026-27.06.2027) and Ryuichi Sakamoto (11.09.2026-20.06.2027); notice of new opening hours from 1 December 2026.

hours.quote: Tue, Wed, Fri 10:00 am-6:00 pm; Thu 10:00 am-8:00 pm; Sat, Sun 11:00 am-6:00 pm. 'From 1 December 2026, new opening hours will apply: Tuesday to Sunday from 10 am to 6 pm.'

proposed.caveats: Access to the Rieckhallen is currently not barrier-free.
